description: Loads the shipped Taktikal Brigade army list (armies/orks_taktikal.json) through the real ArmyListManager path in the running windowed game and asserts the Codex: Orks (11e) Taktikal Brigade enhancement plumbing (WP-O5 rewrite: the pre-codex expectations — Skwad Leader / Mork's Kunnin' — are wrong under the codex, see RULINGS.md WP-O5). (1) The shipped army (regenerated on the codex data, so the pre-codex Mork's Kunnin' is gone from U_WARBOSS_C); an old list that still names Mork's Kunnin' (injected into the loaded army dict) is warned by army validation, and the shipped Warboss has no redeploy enhancement and cannot lead the Kommandos. (2) The same army dict with the codex KILL KOMMANDA on U_WARBOSS_B (and Mork's Kunnin' removed), loaded through ArmyListManager.apply_army_to_game_state: the bearer may lead the Kommandos (LEADER: KOMMANDOS), and while it is part of that Attached unit it has Infiltrators and Stealth; the Kommandos keep their own. A load-path validation scenario (execute_script against the live game, as before); the FormationsPhase attach UI calls the same CharacterAttachmentManager / GameState APIs.
